name: Spinach

basicInfo.description: Spinach is a fast-growing leafy green packed with vitamins and minerals. It thrives in cool weather and can be harvested multiple times during the growing season.
whyGrow: Rich in iron and Vitamin K
Quick harvest – ready in just 4–6 weeks
Great for salads, smoothies, and cooking
basicInfo.sunlight: 4–6 hours of sun daily (tolerates partial shade)
basicInfo.water: Keep soil consistently moist but well-drained

growingSteps: Sow seeds directly in soil, 1–2cm deep
Water regularly to keep soil moist
Harvest outer leaves as needed, leaving inner leaves to grow
Fertilize lightly every 2–3 weeks for continuous harvest

careCalendar.description: Plant directly in cool soil, water gently.
Leave 15–20cm between plants for healthy growth.
Keep soil evenly moist for tender leaves.
Pick outer leaves and let the center keep growing.

symptoms: Brown or yellow spots on leaves

harvestingGuide: Harvest outer leaves once they reach 8–10cm long. Cut just above the crown to allow continuous regrowth. For full harvest, pull entire plant at 6–8 weeks.
estimatedSavings: Growing spinach at home can save $40–70 per season, since fresh bunches cost $3–4 weekly.
